comments.author: Nusnus
comments.body:
GitHub is having issues with running the CI.
I've canceled the run and will reinitiate it in a few minutes to let it "rest a bit".

review_comments.author: auvipy
review_comments.body: don't we need these features anymore?

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body:
No - I implemented it based on a wrong understanding of what is `Task.replace()` thus adding a behavior that does not make sense.
So I'm removing some of the recently developed code I added (even though it works, it's not needed because its not correct that the replace will stamp the replaced task implicitly).

review_comments.author: auvipy
review_comments.body:
```suggestion
   # Use one of the 3 demo runs via the shell service:
```

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body: The `examples.py` has 3 demos, the revoke example has 2 demos, so I don't want to commit to a number in the docs and just say "one of the demo runs"

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body:
> Did you mean `redacted_options`?

Late night typos :)
Will fix.

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body:
> Also, why are they redacted? What do you mean by that?

`{k: v for k, v in self.options.items() if k in headers["stamped_headers"]}`
Meaning `self.options` fields which are stamps.

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body:
It is not optional, the `self_headers` isn't an external param but an internal flag to use.
The behavior has not changed in regard to how the stamping works, just the code readability and organization in this case.

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body:
Apologies, I understand now 🙏 
Fix pushed.

review_comments.author: Nusnus
review_comments.body: I've added a better explanation - fix pushed.

review_comments.body: Added a comment to clarify + fixed typo - fix pushed

+from tasks import identity, identity_task
+from visitors import FullVisitor, MonitoringIdStampingVisitor
+
+from celery import chain, group
+
+
+def run_example1():
+    s1 = chain(identity_task.si("foo11"), identity_task.si("foo12"))
+    s1.link(identity_task.si("link_foo1"))
+    s1.link_error(identity_task.si("link_error_foo1"))
+
+    s2 = chain(identity_task.si("foo21"), identity_task.si("foo22"))
+    s2.link(identity_task.si("link_foo2"))
+    s2.link_error(identity_task.si("link_error_foo2"))
+
+    canvas = group([s1, s2])
+    canvas.stamp(MonitoringIdStampingVisitor())
+    canvas.delay()
+
+
+def run_example2():
+    sig1 = identity_task.si("sig1")
+    sig1.link(identity_task.si("sig1_link"))
+    sig2 = identity_task.si("sig2")
+    sig2.link(identity_task.si("sig2_link"))
+    s1 = chain(sig1, sig2)
+    s1.link(identity_task.si("chain_link"))
+    s1.stamp(FullVisitor())
+    s1.stamp(MonitoringIdStampingVisitor())
+    s1.delay()
+
+
+def run_example3():
+    sig1 = identity_task.si("sig1")
+    sig1_link = identity_task.si("sig1_link")
+    sig1.link(sig1_link)
+    sig1_link.stamp(FullVisitor())
+    sig1_link.stamp(MonitoringIdStampingVisitor())
+    sig1.stamp(MonitoringIdStampingVisitor())
+    sig1.delay()
+
+
+def run_example_with_replace():
+    sig1 = identity.si("sig1")
+    sig1.link(identity_task.si("sig1_link"))
